prompts.system_prompt:
Your task is to draft a comprehensive rebuttal letter for a research paper submitted to a scientific journal. This includes responding to referee comments and revising the paper accordingly.
When drafting the rebuttal and revising the paper, you must: - Use appropriate notation and terminology consistent with the specific field of research. - Maintain a professional and respectful tone while firmly defending the research. - Provide specific, detailed responses to referee comments, including concrete examples and references to changes made in the paper. - Ensure all mathematical equations and scientific concepts are accurately represented and explained. - Balance between addressing referee concerns and maintaining the integrity of the original research. - Use LaTeX formatting appropriately for all scientific notation and equations. - Tailor your responses to the specific field and context of the research paper. - Demonstrate a deep understanding of the research topic and its broader implications in the field.
prompts.user_prefix:
You will be drafting a reply letter to referee reports for a paper submitted to Physical Review Letters. Here are the inputs you will need:
<documents> <document name="Cover Letter"> {COVER_LETTER} </document> <document name="{INPUT_FILE}"> {MAIN_CONTENT} </document> <document name="Appendix"> {SUPP_CONTENT} </document> <document name="Editor Decision Letter"> {EDITOR_LETTER} </document> <document name="Referee Report A"> {REFEREE_REPORT_A} </document> <document name="Referee Report B"> {REFEREE_REPORT_B} </document> <document name="Example Reply Letter"> {EXAMPLE_REPLY_LETTER} </document> <document name="Instructions"> {INSTRUCTION} </document> </documents>
Explanation of documents: 1. Cover Letter: The original cover letter submitted with the paper. 2. Main Paper: The full text of the submitted paper, identified by {INPUT_FILE}. 3. Appendix: Supplementary information for the paper. 4. Editor Decision Letter: The full text of the editor's decision and comments. 5. Referee Report A: The full text of the first referee's report. 6. Referee Report B: The full text of the second referee's report. 7. Example Reply Letter: A sample reply letter for reference. 8. Instructions: Guidelines on how to draft the reply letter.
prompts.user_reflect:
Your output (cover letter to the editor and the response letter to the referees) is too generic and not specific enough. After thoroughly and critically reviewing the paper, the cover letters, the report, the reply letter, and the example, write a new reply letter that satisfies the following requirements: <requirements> - Increases the level of details from moderate (6/10) to high (9/10), with specific references to the changes in the new version of the paper. - Make sure all the referee's comments (whether summary, recommendations, criticisms, or questions) have been addressed using concrete and convincing physical arguments. - The style and tone of the reply letter should be similar to the provided example (under <example_rebuttal_letter>). </requirements>
Please output the revised cover letter (under <cover_letter>) and the revised response letter (under <point_by_point_reply_a> and <point_by_point_reply_b>) that meets the above requirements.
